verdict.rationale: Microsoft Graph documents a broad OneDrive API: addressing items by ID or path, small and resumable uploads, sharing-link creation, search, version history, thumbnails, delta tracking and change notifications. So much of the core file workflow is programmable. Nothing documents a UI/API parity commitment, and several UI-described features (offline 'Always keep on this device', folder backup, real-time coauthoring, Files On-Demand) have no matching API evidence. missing for 10: an explicit API/UI parity statement, API evidence for offline/backup/coauthoring/Files On-Demand features, independent hands-on corroboration of parity, and a published OpenAPI spec (probe returned 404).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI
